stem.text: In a dark room, a small source of red light illuminates two slits that are $0.75\,\text{mm}$ apart. A few metres beyond the slits, the light falls on a screen producing a series of equally spaced bright lines.
Which change would cause the distance between the bright lines on the screen to be reduced?

A.text: Change the source for one emitting blue light.

B.text: Reduce the distance between the light source and the slits.

C.text: Reduce the distance between the slits to $0.55\,\text{mm}$.

D.text: Reduce the intensity of the light source.
